hypothesis: CRS should be represented as joint states (result, margin, total, exact score) instead of a fixed low-score Top-N shortlist.
state_definition: score=(home_goals,away_goals); HAD=result(score); HHAD constrains margin; TTG constrains total; CRS prices the exact/other state.
constraints: High-score states may belong to H, D, or A.
Do not multiply HAD*HHAD*TTG*CRS as if independent.
Other H/D/A buckets remain explicit when exact totals are unknown.
No fixed entropy/tail/candidate threshold is frozen before OOS validation.
